candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: is_farmer
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Whether the action index is the permanent farmer rather than a hired hand.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: target_x
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Candidate target x coordinate; delivery targets use the current worker position.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: target_y
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Candidate target y coordinate; delivery targets use the current worker position.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: travel_actions
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Shortest movement from worker to harvest target; zero for direct carried-inventory delivery.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: manual_cash_actions
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Movement plus HARVEST plus movement plus DROP; direct delivery excludes HARVEST. PASS is represented as zero cost for diagnostics.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: decisions_remaining
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: 719 minus current decision step. PASS rows use zero numeric placeholders; kind masks their meaning.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: deadline_slack
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Remaining decisions minus candidate manual path length.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: within_deadline
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Manual path finishes by step 718. This alone does not imply positive quantity or free capacity.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: yield_alive_on_arrival
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Harvest has positive yield after preceding movement decay, or candidate is a carried-inventory delivery.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: visible_harvest_units
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Currently mature harvest quantity in the legal observation; zero for non-harvest options.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: arrival_harvest_units
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Current yield less intervening pinned turn decay; no refresh/production forecast.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: decayed_units_en_route
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Visible harvest minus arrival harvest quantity.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: carried_units
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: All currently carried items for this worker, including unsellable ones.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: shed_room_now
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: 100 minus all non-seed items currently in own shed.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: accepted_units
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Items admitted by DROP with the shed unchanged until arrival; supplied dictionary order.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: discarded_units
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Carried plus collected items discarded under that DROP scenario.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: frozen_bundle_revenue
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Incremental one-sided liquidation of admitted goods after existing shed stock, at a frozen market.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: marginal_harvest_revenue
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Bundle revenue minus value from dropping previously carried goods alone at the same hypothetical time. Negative values retained.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: price_impact_loss
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Accepted units valued at current headline prices minus their nonlinear incremental sale value.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: capacity_value_loss
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Unlimited-deposit frozen bundle value minus current-capacity bundle value.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: no_decay_revenue
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Counterfactual bundle value omitting travel decay; current capacity still enforced.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: independent_eligible_workers
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Workers whose independent harvest/drop route meets deadline with live yield; ignores shared resource and capacity conflicts.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: only_eligible_worker
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: This worker is the sole deadline/live-yield eligible worker, independent of capacity.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: other_worker_present
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: An alternative worker exists for this harvest target; non-harvest rows use zero.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: fastest_other_worker_actions
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Shortest manual path length among other workers, ignoring their own inventory and task commitments.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: travel_advantage_vs_other
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Fastest other worker manual path minus this worker path; positive means this worker is nearer.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: full_rate
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Candidate ranking probe rate: all registered ingredients. Not learned utility or a future income prediction.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: no_deadline_rate
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Candidate ranking probe rate: omit deadline. Not learned utility or a future income prediction.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: no_decay_rate
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Candidate ranking probe rate: omit decay. Not learned utility or a future income prediction.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: no_capacity_rate
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Candidate ranking probe rate: omit capacity. Not learned utility or a future income prediction.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: no_price_impact_rate
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Candidate ranking probe rate: omit price impact. Not learned utility or a future income prediction.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: other_first_action_present
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: At least one menu option begins with a different command.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: best_other_first_action_rate
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Best full-scenario rate among candidates with a different immediate command.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: first_action_regret_rate
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Best menu rate minus the best rate sharing this candidate first command. Not realized regret.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

candidate_numeric_descriptors.name: independent_top_task_claimants
candidate_numeric_descriptors.meaning: Count of independent full-scenario worker selections claiming this harvest. Not a feasible joint allocation.
candidate_numeric_descriptors.availability: current legal observation or specified scenario only

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.worker_count
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Number of own worker action indices including farmer.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.visible_resources
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Mature positive-yield harvest targets in own visible farm.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.deadline_feasible_candidates
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Non-PASS options meeting the deadline, before further availability/value checks.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.arrival_decay_candidates
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Options losing some visible yield during travel.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.capacity_loss_candidates
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Options whose value decreases under current shed capacity.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.price_impact_candidates
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Options whose nonlinear sale value is below headline pricing.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.negative_marginal_harvest_candidates
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Harvest options that reduce the value of the carried bundle under capacity.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.contested_top_tasks
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Harvest targets independently preferred by multiple workers.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.workers_claiming_contested_top_tasks
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Workers whose independent first option targets a contested harvest.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.pass_selections
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Workers selecting PASS under the full probe.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.maximum_individual_rate
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Largest independently selected worker rate; not joint income.

aggregate_state_candidates.name: action.mean_individual_rate
aggregate_state_candidates.meaning: Mean independently selected worker rate; not joint income.
